narration.text: Near the top, Future. Travis Scott. Then one dot with open air under it. More than both of them added together.
narration.measuredTranscript: them near the top. Future. Travis Scott. Then one dot with open air under it. More than both of them added together.

acceptableDurationSeconds.note: Descriptive. Corpus median 9.0s, p75 14.0s. Never a cap: the evidence sets the length.

internalChangeBudget.note: Advisory. May suggest splitting a unit, but never rejects a candidate and never forces a split. Overridden whenever the content needs the time.

contract.takeaway: One dot sits above Future and Travis Scott combined, with open air beneath it.

claims.text: Future and Travis Scott sit near the top of the field.
One artist exceeds both of them added together.

requiredMedia.contentRequirement: Verified daily play values for all three on a fixed declared scale, so the gap is the real ratio.
Approved cutouts for the three named artists.

visualEvents.description: Future's mark is identified near the top.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: Then one dot with open air under it
visualEvents.description: The outlier appears with visible empty space below it.
visualEvents.matchedTranscript: Then one dot with open air under it.

visualEvents.triggerPhrase: More than both of them added together
visualEvents.description: The sum of the two is shown falling short of the one.
visualEvents.matchedTranscript: More than both of them added together.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not rescale to the supplied minimum and maximum.
prohibitions.reason: The open air under the dot is the claim. Relative rescaling destroys it.

prohibitions.prohibition: Do not treat marker size, glow or depth as magnitude.

successConditions: The gap reads as a real distance.
failureConditions: The outlier looks marginally higher rather than far above.
The combined value of two is never shown.
